postal_system.assignment_rule: SCPT assigns seven digits. UPU 09/2022 places them to the left of the province or city-province. Parsing 10-04-13-1 does not itself validate a current assignment; exact SCPT rows remain source-qualified.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A postcode may become drawable only from a valid Polygon/MultiPolygon at the exact delivery-area or neighbourhood granularity, reconciled to an authoritative assignment with compatible rights. Points, facilities, routes, buffers, hulls, cells and broader administrative areas are rejected.
postal_system.address_rule: Keep recipient, street/premises, neighbourhood/sector/village, commune/territory, postcode and province separate. P.O. box and poste restante remain delivery objects.
postal_system.agid_rule: An AGID cell or ID is independent spatial context. It may be shown beside a source-qualified search result but is not an SCPT postcode, assignment or postal boundary.
postal_system.model_rule: Hugging Face, libpostal and other models may parse or rank candidates only. They cannot create postal truth, geometry, licence or building identity.
postal_system.building_rule: Detailed place or building display requires its own source identity and relation. Postcode membership or proximity never identifies a building, resident, owner or delivery point.
postal_system.licence_rule: SCPT web/API, UPU and ARPTC bodies are reference evidence. SCPT all-rights-reserved and UPU/database conditions do not establish bulk AGID redistribution rights. OSM ODbL data remains a separate attributed partition.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO CD and DR Congo territory; do not merge with CG or reinterpret foreign assignments.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Retain retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256; re-check after the pending-country pass or a competent-authority release.

stages.definition: Legacy CD address metadata without the official seven-digit postcode format.
Digest-bound SCPT, UPU and ARPTC postal evidence, corrected seven-digit address metadata, source/rights boundaries, OSM/Hugging Face candidate audit and a deterministic no-proxy quality gate.

M2 requires a current complete versioned SCPT or competent-authority denominator of every seven-digit assignment, stable row identity, alias, validity, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area object with compatible AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving rights. Each drawable code must reconcile to a real valid Polygon/MultiPolygon at the exact postal granularity with official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method and confidence. Points, offices, routes, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster/AGID cells, broader province/city/commune geometry, unrelated features, model output and the existing synthetic CD planning pack are prohibited proxies. The immutable artifact must drive the real CD API/app through normalization, loading, no-match, multiple, failure, invalid geometry, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear and re-search while showing code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: Seven-digit metadata, exact source rows, independently sourced search/place context and candidate rejection only; no CD Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Complete rights-cleared assignments and exact postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifacts must pass the CD quality gate and real API/app verification.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a CD postal area. A separate civic place, point, building or AGID cell stays source-qualified and non-postal.
